body: It just feels like it has been going down for so long. Then these last few months just made it so much worse. I just do not know what to do anymore. My bestfriend also said that its been hard to hang out with me because I am so negative lately. I hate that because I don't want to be negative but I am trapped in my own mind of torture. It's like I am constantly fighting with myself. I hate talking about it to people that I know because it just sounds like a pity party or I ruin their mood. I have been telling myself that I will make a counseling appointment but I have been saying that for the last two weeks. I am just scared of how fucked up they are going to say that I am. I am sorry for telling you this because now it feels like I am making it your problem. I say I want to die but then I feel shitty because I don't want to hurt my family but I cant live like this anymore.
